label: 053.Western_Grebe
summary: The Western Grebe (Sterna grebe) is an avian species characterized by specialized plumage and foraging adaptations. It primarily inhabits coastal beaches, barrier islands, and offshore marine waters, where its diet consists primarily of small forage fish, sand lance, anchovies, and marine worms.
habitat: Coastal beaches, barrier islands, and offshore marine waters
diet: Small forage fish, sand lance, anchovies, and marine worms
